work.title: Build the Redwood physician-group QoR MVP
authority: Direct user-approved HIVEFORGE BUILD BRIEF: Project Redwood — Physician Group QoR MVP v0.1

intent.productGoal: Transform unseen physician-group transaction source files into a canonical model, reviewed QoR analysis, and populated formula-driven XLSX without manual workbook rebuilding.
intent.capability: Provide an inspectable ingestion-to-workbook vertical slice with configurable MethodProfile, exact-cent calculations, explicit reconciliation differences, professional-review primitives, and lineaged output.
architecturalIntent: Methodology is executable, versioned configuration rather than global hard-coded policy.
Source evidence, canonical model, calculations, professional decisions, and workbook output remain separable artifacts.
The frozen Higgsfield prototype is UX reference only.
invariants: Redwood never silently forces financial populations to balance.
Blanks, signs, unavailable values, and source lineage are preserved or explicitly quarantined.
Observed, expected, and adjusted amounts remain distinct.
Professional policy remains configurable and approval-bound.
acceptanceEvidence: Core unit tests cover money parsing, reconciliation visibility, recovery sensitivity, and formula-driven workbook structure.
ENG001 demo reproduces stated control differences with source lineage.
Generated XLSX opens through ExcelJS and contains required formula and trace sheets.

decisions.decision: Use a TypeScript pnpm workspace with a pure core package before introducing persistence or UI.
decisions.rationale: A pure evidence-producing engine provides a testable canonical foundation and does not allow the reference prototype to dictate architecture.

decisions.decision: Seed a DRAFT method contract because the claimed pre-existing artifact was absent.
decisions.rationale: The seed is explicitly not professional authority; the absence is recorded as a known divergence.

observedBehaviour: The repository baseline had no method contract, package manifest, canonical application, or fixture corpus.
The core implementation imports CSV/XLSX data string-first, retains hashes and source rows, produces visible differences, and generates a formula-bearing XLSX in the ENG001 demo.
The local workbench accepts four source files, creates an active analysis run, renders the professional workflow states, and downloads a run-bound workbook through its API.

evidence.result: 7 tests passed: money parsing, difference visibility, recovery sensitivity, full workbook sheet/formula audit, XLSX ingestion, claim-version/adjustment handling, and ENG002 mixed-snapshot controls.
Generated from the ENG001 synthetic fixture with Executive Summary, Reconciliation, Assumptions, Findings, and Source Trace sheets.
Reproduced $750.00 all-cash/GL, $1,071.45 matched-cash/GL, and $1,405.01 A/R/GL differences without balancing entries.
Created a run from four source files, returned three reconciliation controls and two findings, and downloaded a 10,893-byte XLSX artifact.

evidence.reference: Local XLSX upload verification against apps/workbench/server.mjs
evidence.result: Uploaded an A/R XLSX source, selected worksheet AR, and constructed a run containing one canonical receivable with snapshot date 2026-06-30.
Created run 972691d2-2989-463b-87c7-a861b3b42824 and a G3 review decision, restarted the server, then restored the same run with its bound decision.
Constructed a run with 14 explicit mapping decisions and approved the claim_id mapping through the run-bound API with reviewer Mapper.

divergences.expected: The build brief says a pre-existing methodology/redwood-qor-v0.1.json contract exists.
divergences.observed: No methodology directory or contract was in the baseline.

divergences.expected: The MVP includes CSV and XLSX ingestion, persistence, a professional workbench, and full multi-sheet QoR coverage.
divergences.observed: The current slice implements CSV plus selected-worksheet XLSX ingestion, typed adjustments, a run-scoped local workbench, ENG001/ENG002 fixtures, and a twelve-sheet workbook; durable persistence, mapping review decisions, full G0–G7 authorization, and held-out proof remain incomplete.

learning.recurringPattern: Financial source controls can have similar labels with distinct populations; preserving population definitions is necessary to avoid false contradictions.
learning.improvementProposal: Persist first-class source/control/mapping artifacts before expanding UI so every result and decision can be reconstructed.
